items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-09-30
items.q: See, even the Peter Ron, even the Peter Buccott. He was better. See, he had more knowledge of the violin.

ctx.x: Who did Herbert Lindsay play with?

Now, Herbert Lindsay, that was a crackerjack violin player. He was one of the best. Now, you call the man's name there. He was one of the best violinists that I would listen to for this particular reason. Herbert Lindsay could make more, yet, listen, yet he's an air player. But he could make more double stops in a manner I renew in my life. See, from anything he played. And catch it right now, solo, classic, or whatever it was. And make all double, fashion, he could make more double stops. And then he ran out of…
But where did he play Herbert Lindsay? Did he play along?
